title: Cambridge International A Level Further Mathematics 9231 syllabus

source.method: Owner supplied the Paper 2 chapter list directly (chapters 1-6); the full syllabus PDF was not opened. Each chapter here has one placeholder section/outcome so question topics have a valid ref to point at. Not a full extraction of the syllabus document.

outcomes.text: Hyperbolic functions: definitions, identities, inverse hyperbolic functions, derivatives and integrals.
Matrices: determinants, inverses, systems of linear equations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, diagonalisation.
Differentiation: implicit and parametric differentiation, higher derivatives.
Integration: reduction formulae, techniques of integration, numerical estimation of definite integrals (upper/lower bounds).
Complex numbers: de Moivre's theorem, roots of unity, series involving complex exponentials.
Differential equations: first order linear equations (integrating factor), second order linear equations with constant coefficients.
